title: 한글 한눈에: 자음 14, 모음 10
objective: By the end, you can tell the basic consonants from the vowels, put a consonant and a vowel together into one syllable block, and read short words such as 나무 and 우유 out loud.
summary: Hangul spells sounds with 14 basic consonants and 10 basic vowels, which combine into one block for each syllable.

task.title: Build and read blocks
task.line: Use the letter chart and the block rule on page 1 to answer each item.

letters.letter: 자음 14: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅅ ㅇ ㅈ ㅊ ㅋ ㅌ ㅍ ㅎ
letters.sound: Consonants, e.g. ㄴ [n], ㅁ [m], ㅅ [s], ㅎ [h], ㄷ [d], ㅂ [b], ㅈ [j]
letters.as: ㄴ like n in 'no', ㅁ like m in 'me'

letters.letter: 모음 10: ㅏ ㅑ ㅓ ㅕ ㅗ ㅛ ㅜ ㅠ ㅡ ㅣ
letters.sound: Vowels, e.g. ㅏ [a], ㅓ [eo], ㅕ [yeo], ㅗ [o], ㅜ [u], ㅣ [i]
letters.as: ㅏ like a in 'father', ㅣ like ee in 'see'

letters.sound: ㅇ at the start is silent: 아 [a], 우 [u]
letters.as: A placeholder only; say just the vowel

letters.sound: One block = one syllable: ㄴ + ㅏ = 나 [na]
letters.as: Tall vowels (ㅏ ㅓ ㅣ) sit on the right; flat ones (ㅗ ㅜ ㅡ) sit below

exercises: Put the letters together into one syllable block: ① ㄱ + ㅏ ② ㅁ + ㅜ ③ ㅎ + ㅗ ④ ㅅ + ㅣ
Split each block into its consonant and vowel: ① 너 ② 수 ③ 디 ④ 후
Is it a consonant or a vowel? ① ㅌ ② ㅕ ③ ㅡ ④ ㅂ
How many syllable blocks does each word have? ① 커피 ② 고구마 ③ 소 ④ 아이
Write the sound of each word in Roman letters: ① 지도 ② 두부 ③ 여우 ④ 나무
Write the sound of each block in Roman letters: ① 나 ② 우 ③ 이 ④ 오
answers: ① 가 ② 무 ③ 호 ④ 시
① ㄴ + ㅓ ② ㅅ + ㅜ ③ ㄷ + ㅣ ④ ㅎ + ㅜ
① Consonant ② Vowel ③ Vowel ④ Consonant
① jido ② dubu ③ yeou ④ namu
① na ② u ③ i ④ o
